Import Timesheets

Paste or upload a CSV with consultant name, period, and hours. Each row is validated before saving.

Required columns (header row must be first):
consultant_name — must match an existing consultant exactly (case-insensitive)
period_start and period_end — YYYY-MM-DD format
hours_worked — positive number (e.g. 80, 160, 37.5)
